lines: The reunion phase I even dreamed of.
The echoing command that never dries.
I wonder what face of you I’ll meet.
I have only things I want to say.
I want to make you laugh.
How many times I search for you again.
Each time we meet, I fall in love.
The heart that lives on inside me remains unchanged.
With steps that blow away sorrow.
In a world that never looks back.
That single ray of light that pierced through.
Finding that smile over and over.
Your exclusive warmth in my arms.
Today again the morning carries the days.
The feeling of only living in a dream.
How many times I search for you again.
Each time we meet, I fall in love.
The heart that lives on inside me remains unchanged.
I want to keep dancing with you.
